stories.title: Mold, Holywell and Talacre public toilet handover still unresolved as running costs exceed budget
stories.summary: More than six months after Flintshire County Council agreed to hand its last three public toilets to town and community councils, no transfer has been agreed, and the council says running them now costs more than it has budgeted. stories.title: Flintshire rights of way team “increasingly challenged” to keep paths safe, report says
stories.summary: Flintshire’s rights of way network would need an extra £97,000 a year just to keep paths in their current condition, and a further £167,000 a year to bring them up to an acceptable standard, according to a council report. stories.title: E-bike seized in Connah’s Quay after breaching 250W legal power limit
